_about: Converts cousinoer5's Altered Insanity (an edited DT3 1.5.2.4, decompiled with gm8decompiler and split with gmksplit --preserve-ids) into a DT3+ mod folder: python tools/modkit/convert.py tools/modkit/altered_insanity/config.json, then python tools/modkit/validate.py <out> <project>. 'vanilla' is the original game split the same way: the DT3_v1_5_2_4_v120_gmksplit folder of this repository's commit fe70bd6d, unzipped into tools/modkit/_vanilla (git archive --format=zip -o vanilla.zip fe70bd6d DT3_v1_5_2_4_v120_gmksplit). Paths are this computer's.
